Frequently Asked Questions

When should I start preparing for IELTS?+
Ideally 3–6 months before your exam date. Our counsellors will map a prep timeline based on your current English level and target band score.
Who accepts IELTS scores?+
Over 11,000 organisations in 140+ countries — including top universities in UK, Canada, Australia, and USA. Cambridge makes IELTS, which is why our partnership gives you exclusive preparation material.
What band score do I need for UK/Canada universities?+
Most UK and Canadian universities require 6.0–7.0 overall. Our Cambridge-trained faculty have an excellent track record helping students hit target bands in the first attempt.
How do I access live classes and Cambridge material?+
After enrollment you receive a personalised login and exclusive access to the Cambridge study portal with 70+ mock tests, vocabulary modules, and AI feedback on writing & speaking.
Can I book a one-on-one doubt session?+
Absolutely. Call +91 90444 42989 or fill the form above to schedule a free 30-min counseling session with a Cambridge-certified expert.
What is a good TOEFL score for top universities?+
Most top universities require a TOEFL iBT score of 90–105+. Ivy League and Russell Group universities typically expect 100+. Our coaching covers all four sections — Reading, Listening, Speaking, and Writing — with AI-scored mock tests.
How long does it take to prepare for TOEFL?+
Most students are ready in 4–8 weeks with focused preparation. Our TOEFL programme includes a diagnostic assessment on day one to build a targeted study plan and cut down unnecessary prep time.
Is Duolingo English Test accepted by top universities?+
Yes — over 5,000 universities now accept the Duolingo English Test, including many in the USA, UK, Canada, and Australia. It is fast (1 hour), affordable, and results come within 48 hours. Our coaching targets 120+ which meets requirements at most partner universities.
What Duolingo score do I need for a USA or Canada admit?+
Most universities require a minimum of 105–120. Top-ranked institutions may ask for 125+. Our adaptive programme focuses on all four Duolingo subscores — Literacy, Comprehension, Conversation, and Production — to maximise your overall score efficiently.
What PTE score is required for Australian universities?+
Australian universities typically require PTE Academic 50–65 overall, with Group of Eight universities asking for 65+. PTE is also accepted for the Australian student visa (subclass 500) at a minimum of 50. Our coaching focuses on AI-scored components and time-management strategies.
How is PTE different from IELTS?+
PTE is entirely computer-based and AI-scored, with results in 24–48 hours — much faster than IELTS. It integrates multiple skills simultaneously, which suits certain learner types. Our counsellors will help you pick the right exam based on your target university, timeline, and learning style.
